text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A memorable day marking the beginning of 
our challenge in the Twinkle Series 
alongside Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's a one-on-one duel!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon was engaged in a "one-on-one 
showdown."

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, as bold as ever, Hishi Ama-nee-san! 
Knock 'em dead~!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, but our dorm leader's gonna win! 
Just look at that light, nimble lead!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming off the fourth corner and onto the 
final stretch. Fuji Kiseki leads ahead 
with a cool expression. Maintaining a 
comfortable lead, however—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon gave a combative grin.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: As if I'd loseee!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I won't let you pass...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With burning spirit, Hishi Amazon rapidly 
closed in on Fuji Kiseki's back—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, amid the cheers, they plunged 
across the finish line neck and neck.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant*! Aaaaahhh~! Crushed it!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You've gotten quite a bit stronger again. 
My back felt practically numb.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. My Debut race is coming right up, 
after all! Of course I'm all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, Fuji! You were burning 
exceptionally hot out there today too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I meant it as a farewell gift of 
sorts, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Go reach even greater heights in the 
Twinkle Series, Hishi Ama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Fuji, you really are something else...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~! The dorm leaders are having a 
super heated conversation~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Kya?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon looked up this way— and was 
surprised by the juniors cheering and 
waving at her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: When did they get here?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Did you enjoy Hishiama's 
commemorative send-off race?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Don't tell me, Fuji, you only talked 
about giving them a send-off because those 
guys were there...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, don't put your arm around me! 
Don't wave at me! You ain't foolin' me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cheerful cheers of her juniors 
continued to echo under the blue sky for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that was a fiery, awesome race, no 
doubt about it. Really learned a lot.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Big sis puts her heart and soul into 
one-on-one battles! So of course it's 
gonna turn into a red-hot race!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I've been wondering for a while, why does 
Hishi Ama-senpai love competing so much?"

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Umm, if I recall correctly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the two of them chat, I'm 
suddenly reminded of asking Hishi Amazon a 
similar question before. Her reply back 
then was, if I recall—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Guess she takes after her mother.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My mom... she actually made quite a name 
for herself overseas, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course you'd admire them, and it 
naturally makes you interested in racing 
too!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I seeee. Seeing your mom run in an amazing 
race would definitely make anyone look up 
to her~

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: It's not a race, it's a one-on-one duel!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, why a "one-on-one duel" 
instead of a race?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Why are you calling it a 
"one-on-one duel" anyway?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd accepted it without thinking, but—why 
does she call races "one-on-ones"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after resolving to ask if the 
opportunity arose, the reason became clear 
surprisingly fast.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Trainee. Making you stick around 
for my voluntary practice and all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I watched over Hishi Amazon stretching 
on the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Bono & Biko
text_block_list.text: Nuuuuugh~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, a hero-loving Umamusume, and 
Hishi Akebono, an Umamusume with a big 
body and an equally big heart, went 
tearing along under the elevated tracks.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh. A one-on-one under the overpass, huh? 
That takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, back when I was a kid, I had a 
one-on-one fistfight under an overpass 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The reason was just some silly turf war, I 
think. I ended up running with all my 
might against the neighborhood bully.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, that might've been 
my very first one-on-one duel.

text_block_list.name: Bono & Biko
text_block_list.text:
Full power, full power, full poweeer~! I'm 
gonna be the one to wiiin~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus clung fiercely to Hishi 
Akebono's heels. It was such a close race, 
you couldn't take your eyes off it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...With great Umamusume like them, their 
burning spirits are right beside me, 
blazing hot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I knew racing was hype and all. But 
knowin' it and actually doin' it are two 
totally different things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the riverbank bathed in the setting 
sun, the two threw themselves recklessly 
across the finish line as if crashing into 
each other.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even as a kid, I couldn't believe 
something this fun actually existed.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhh!! I beat Bono todayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... phew~~. Ahhh~, they caught 
up to me~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Biko-chan, you've gotten faster 
again~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two carried on chatting excitedly 
under the overpass, without showing any 
sign of noticing me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clashing against a strong opponent and 
getting fired up. That is Hishi Amazon's 
'one-on-one showdown'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I finally understood a little 
why she refers to races as 'one-on-one 
brawls.'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm super excited for the 
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about what kind of 
one-on-one duel awaits gives me the 
shivers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that being said, I'm counting on 
you for tons more support from here on 
out!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! Hey, you guys! Time to wrap it 
up and head inside! Rain clouds are 
coming, you'll catch a cold!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hishi Ama-san! Just a little bit more, 
pleeease—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, just a little bit more! Come 
on, please?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you come home right now, Big Sis will 
make you her special carrot steak tonight!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really!? Yay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hishi Amazon watches over the two of them 
with gentle eyes as they bustle off back 
to the dorms."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Good grief, you guys really are a handful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, my days of climbing the Twinkle 
Series alongside this passionate, hearty, 
and slightly motherly girl had begun.
